numericEquivalentDifferences.english: This 4-foot-tall bronze drum comes with a pair of iron mallets. A creature can activate the drums as an action, causing the hammers to float above the drum and strike it to produce a thundering rhythm. For the next minute, the ship gains one additional action, as long as it has at least one action. Once this item is used, it can't be activated again for {@dice 2d10} hours.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 這個4尺高的青銅鼓配有一對鐵槌。一個生物可以以一個動作啟用鼓，使鐵槌漂浮在鼓上方並敲擊它產生雷鳴般的節奏。在接下來的1分鐘內，只要船舶至少有一個動作，它就會獲得一個額外的動作。一旦使用了這個物品，它就不能在{@dice 2d10}小時內再次啟用。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Bombards are built by giff. The major feature of each ship is an enormous cannon that fires massive cannon balls capable of blowing other ships to smithereens. (The cannon is included in the cost of the ship.) A bombard can carry up to fourteen giant cannon balls, each of which weighs 10 tons. These cannon balls make up most of the weight of the ship's cargo. A winch mounted on the aft deck is used to load the cannon balls on board.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 炮艦們由詰弗河馬人打造。她們的主要特徵便是口徑碩大的巨炮，其發射的巨型炮彈能將其他艦船炸成碎片（大炮售價包含在艦船的價格之中）。一艘炮艦可以最多攜帶 14 枚巨型炮彈，每個重達 10 噸。而這些炮彈也佔據了艦船大部分的載貨量。在艦船尾甲板上安裝有一個絞盤，它被用於將巨型炮彈裝填到艦船上。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Return the pot to medium-high heat, add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil, and warm until shimmering. Add the onions and 1 teaspoon salt and cook, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pot occasionally, until the onions begin to soften and release some liquid, about 4 minutes. Adjust the heat to medium-low and continue cooking for 15 minutes, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pot occasionally and adjusting the heat as necessary to make sure the onions are cooking gently, not scorching. Add the thyme, ginger, and flour and continue to cook, stirring, until the onions are sticky and golden, about 5 minutes more. Add the cider, broth, and ½ teaspoon salt. Stir and scrape the bottom of the pot to loosen and dissolve the browned bits.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 將鍋放回中高火，加入剩餘的1湯匙油，加熱至油麵發亮。加入洋蔥和1茶匙鹽，偶爾攪拌並刮鍋底，直到洋蔥開始變軟並釋放一些液體，大約4分鐘。調整火力至中低，繼續烹飪15分鐘，偶爾攪拌並刮鍋底，必要時調整火力以確保洋蔥溫和地烹飪，不燒焦。加入百里香、姜和麵粉，繼續烹飪，攪拌，直到洋蔥變得粘糊且金黃色，大約再5分鐘。加入蘋果酒、肉湯和半茶匙鹽。攪拌並刮鍋底以鬆動並溶解焦化的碎屑。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Remove the twine from the beef and cut it against the grain into ½-inch-thick slices (or pull it apart into pieces). Place the meat on the platter with the onions and pears, pour the seasoned juices over the meat, sprinkle with the remaining parsley, and serve.

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: In a small bowl, mix together the cocoa powder, chili powder, cinnamon, oregano, cumin, allspice, cloves, cayenne, ½ teaspoon salt, and ½ teaspoon pepper. Set aside.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 在一個小碗中，將可可粉、辣椒粉、肉桂、牛至、孜然、五香粉、丁香、卡宴辣椒粉、半茶匙鹽和半茶匙胡椒混合在一起。放在一邊備用。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: In a food processor, combine the cream cheese, lemon juice, paprika, cayenne, and ½ teaspoon salt and season with black pepper. Process until smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides of the work bowl, using a flexible spatula as necessary. Add about half the steamed salmon and process until well combined, again stopping to scrape down the sides of the work bowl as necessary. Scrape the mixture into a medium bowl, add the remaining steamed salmon, the shallots, smoked salmon, and chives. Using the spatula, fold the mixture until well combined. Adjust the seasoning with additional lemon juice, salt, and pepper, if necessary. Cover and refrigerate to let the flavors blend, about 30 minutes.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 在食品加工機中，混合奶油芝士、檸檬汁、辣椒粉、辣椒粉和半茶匙鹽，並用黑胡椒調味。處理至光滑，必要時停下來用橡皮刮刀刮下工作碗的側面。加入大約一半的蒸三文魚，處理至充分混合，同樣在必要時停下來刮下工作碗的側面。將混合物刮入一箇中等大小的碗中，加入剩餘的蒸三文魚、紅蔥頭、燻三文魚和細香蔥。使用橡皮刮刀，將混合物摺疊混合均勻。如有必要，用額外的檸檬汁、鹽和胡椒調整調味。蓋上蓋子，放入冰箱中讓味道融合，大約30分鐘。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Add ½ teaspoon salt and the lotus, cover, and cook until just tender-crisp, about 1½ minutes (the water won't return to a full boil). Drain the lotus and immediately add to the ice water to stop the cooking. Drain again and set aside.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 同時，在中等大小的鍋中加水，用大火煮沸。加入半茶匙鹽和蓮藕，蓋上蓋子，煮至剛好變得柔嫩脆口，大約1分半鐘（水不會再次完全沸騰）。將蓮藕瀝乾，立即加入冰水中以停止烹飪。再次瀝乾並放置一旁。

numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 取出月桂葉；加入醋、大部分歐芹、半茶匙鹽；用胡椒調味；攪拌均勻。如有必要，用額外的鹽和胡椒調整調味。將混合物轉移到上菜的盤子中，放置一邊。用紙巾擦拭乾淨不沾鍋。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Scrape the potato mixture into a piping bag fitted with a ½-inch star tip. Hold the filled pastry bag slightly above the prepared baking sheet and apply steady, gentle, downward pressure to pipe a mound roughly 2 inches in diameter and 2 inches high. Work your way out in a tight circular motion, and then back in again to build height. Pipe twenty mounds total, with about 1 inch between them (five rows of four mounds). Lightly coat the mounds with cooking spray.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 將馬鈴薯混合物刮入裝有半吋星形嘴的裱花袋中。將裝滿的裱花袋稍微舉在準備好的烤盤上方，施加穩定、溫和的向下壓力，擠出直徑大約2吋、高2吋的小堆。以緊密的圓形運動向外工作，然後再向內回縮以增加高度。總共擠出二十個小堆，每個小堆之間大約有1吋的間隔（五排，每排四個小堆）。輕輕用烹飪噴霧噴覆小堆。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Once the cheese has softened, add 1 teaspoon of honey and the pistachios to the cheese and stir well with a fork. Add salt and pepper. Stuff each fig with about 1 teaspoon of the goat cheese mixture. Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 5 to 7 minutes, until the cheese looks soft and the figs begin to release their juices. Drizzle with the remaining tablespoon of honey and sprinkle with some more black pepper. Serve either warm or cold.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 乳酪一旦軟化，就加入1茶匙蜂蜜和開心果到乳酪中，並用叉子攪拌均勻。加入鹽和胡椒。每個無花果填充大約1茶匙的山羊乳酪混合物。淋上橄欖油，烤5到7分鐘，直到乳酪看起來變軟，無花果開始釋放它們的汁液。淋上剩餘的1湯匙蜂蜜，再撒些黑胡椒。趁熱或冷食均可。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: The ½ teaspoon of crushed red pepper will provide a noticeable, moderate heat. If you prefer a more intense heat, use up to 1 teaspoon. You can give the drink more flavor nuance by replacing the crushed red pepper flakes with toasted chile. Toast half of a small dried California, pasilla, or guajillo chile in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, 4 to 5 minutes. Cool the chile and tear into very small (½-inch) pieces. For extra heat, use some of the chile seeds as well.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 半茶匙碎紅辣椒片會提供一種明顯而適中的辣度。如果您更喜歡更強烈的辣味，可以使用多達1茶匙。您可以透過用烤過的辣椒替換碎紅辣椒片來給飲品增添更多風味層次。將半個小幹加利福尼亞辣椒、帕西拉辣椒或瓜希略辣椒在中火的乾鍋中烤至香味四溢，大約需要4到5分鐘。讓辣椒冷卻後撕成非常小的（半吋）碎片。如果需要額外的辣度，也可以使用一些辣椒籽。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: About 10 minutes after flipping the eggplant slices, in a medium skillet over medium heat, warm the olive oil. Add the shallot and ½ teaspoon salt and cook, stirring constantly, until the shallot starts to soften, about 2 minutes. Add the garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 40 seconds. Add the tomatoes, shake the pan to coat them with oil, and cook, shaking the skillet occasionally, until they soften but do not collapse completely, about 4 minutes, adding the sugar halfway through cooking. Add the vinegar and parsley and toss to distribute. Adjust the seasoning with additional salt if necessary.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 在翻面茄子片大約10分鐘後，在中火的中等平底鍋中加熱橄欖油。加入紅蔥頭和半茶匙鹽，不斷攪拌，直到紅蔥頭開始變軟，大約2分鐘。加入大蒜，攪拌至香味釋放，大約40秒。加入番茄，搖晃平底鍋使其沾上油，偶爾搖晃平底鍋，直到它們變軟但不會完全塌陷，大約4分鐘，在烹飪過程中加入糖。加入醋和歐芹，拌勻以分佈。如有需要，用額外的鹽調整調味。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: In a food processor, combine the Melba toast and ½ teaspoon salt, season with pepper, and process until you have fine, uniform crumbs, about the texture of wheat germ. Add ¼ cup of the minced shallots and pulse to combine. Transfer the mixture to a shallow dish. In a second shallow dish, beat the egg and 1 teaspoon of the mustard until uniform. Dip a slice of goat cheese into the egg, covering both sides and the edges. Then dip into the Melba toast mixture, gently pressing the crumbs onto the cheese to form a thick coating, and place on a plate. Repeat with the remaining cheese slices, adding them to the plate as you go. Put the plate in the freezer and freeze until the cheese is very firm, about 45 minutes.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 在食品加工機中，將梅爾巴吐司和半茶匙鹽混合，用胡椒調味，處理直到你得到細膩、均勻的碎屑，質地大約像小麥胚芽。加入半杯切碎的紅蔥頭並快速攪拌混合。將混合物轉移到一個淺盤中。在第二個淺盤中，將雞蛋和1茶匙芥末攪拌均勻。將一片山羊乳酪浸入雞蛋液中，覆蓋兩面和邊緣。然後將其浸入梅爾巴吐司混合物中，輕輕按壓碎屑到乳酪上，形成厚塗層，並放在盤子上。用剩餘的乳酪片重複此操作，一邊進行一邊將它們放在盤子上。將盤子放入冰箱冷凍，直到乳酪非常堅固，大約45分鐘。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Meanwhile, in a large nonreactive bowl, combine the vinegar, lemon juice, remaining 1 teaspoon mustard, and ½ teaspoon salt; season with pepper; and whisk to incorporate. numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 同時，在一個大的非反應性碗中，混合醋、檸檬汁、剩餘的1茶匙芥末和半茶匙鹽；用胡椒調味；並攪拌以混合。加入剩餘的半杯紅蔥頭並放置一旁，讓味道混合，大約10分鐘。在劇烈攪拌的同時，緩慢而穩定地加入橄欖油，混合並乳化成調料。如有需要，用額外的鹽和胡椒調整調味，並放置一旁。
